subject.title: Dashboard: widget publish + community registry — the ecosystem half of the gallery

question: Should dashboard widget publishing and registry browsing be a bundled OpenClaw dashboard feature, a ClawHub-backed package model, or an external experiment until the base dashboard stack lands?
rationale: The issue creates a new dashboard distribution and trust boundary; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose the permanent product/security model.

options.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the publish/browse/install flow to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the base dashboard stack settles.

options.title: External Experiment First
options.body: Ask contributors to prototype widget publishing as an external plugin or ClawHub package until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard distribution.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Close or pause the widget registry path if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to own a dashboard widget ecosystem surface right now.

recommendation.title: Design ClawHub-Backed Registry
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the publish/browse/install flow to use ClawHub or package-style trust metadata plus explicit widget approvals after the base dashboard stack settles.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest merged plugin-tab precedent and the relevant plugin/ClawHub routing guardrails in current repository history.
